modifications.codegen: Whole-program optimisation: internal functions use register conventions (L in ECX, next arg in EDX, rest on stack), cdecl kept only for varargs (luaL_error, lua_pushfstring); errorlimit/enterlevel/tofile/readable/loaderror inlined into callers; unreferenced functions dropped; loadlib.c placed apart from the rest

recommendation: Do not hand-reconstruct any of these ~614 functions. Import the stock lua-5.1.1 source already fetched by the build (build/win32/_deps/lua511-src) and apply three edits: lauxlib.c l_alloc -> game allocator wrapper (alloc/copy/free), lbaselib.c base_funcs without dofile, lmathlib.c without random/randomseed; drop linit.c and model the game's masked opener 0x00b6a020 as game code.
Use this address->source map (and the luaL_Reg tables, which are authoritative) to annotate Ghidra; the table-only entry points need functions created first.

Binary identity with the shipped code is not expected: it was compiled with MSVC 2005 /GL (LTCG) inside the game project, so register conventions, inlining and ordering differ from a stock static library. Matching should be source-level (function identity + behaviour), with an ABI note that internal calls pass lua_State* in ECX.
Treat luaMW_* bindings, the script-state constructor (0x00b6a020), the 'DoFile' replacement and the MPAK-based script loader as game code outside this inventory.
